Subject: Cloud private-offer MAP & evaluation plan — Aurora Health

Hi Jordan / Monica,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — great to see the integration fit with Aurora Health's patient portal. Per our conversation I put together a concise Mutual Action Plan (attached) to accelerate the procurement and evaluation steps. High level summary below + asks.

Quick MAP highlights (attachment: Aurora_MAP_v2.xlsx):
- Evaluation window: 2 weeks (pilot org of 12 users) — target start: 2026-05-18, end: 2026-05-31
- Acceptance criteria: 99% availability for business hours, avg p95 latency < 400ms, and no PHI persistence in logs (we'll show config)
- Procurement path: AWS Marketplace Private Offer preferred (billing via Aurora account), alternative is direct PO to Redwood (longer path)
- Close timeline: aim to sign private-offer + SOW by 2026-05-21 to meet your June rollout calendar

Immediate asks for procurement team:
1) Please confirm the billing account ID you want used for the AWS private offer (next step for us to generate the offer).
2) Procurement checklist — will your finance team accept an AWS Marketplace private offer or do they require a supplier PO + net-30?
3) Any standard security addenda needed before SOW? We have SOC2 docs and can supply an evidence bundle.

Next steps from Redwood:
- I'll loop Marcus (private-offer ops) to initiate the AWS private-offer request once we have your account ID.
- Laura will draft a short SOW for pilot scope + success criteria and route for signature (DocuSign).

Attachments: Aurora_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP + checklist), Aurora_Private_Offer_Instructions.pdf (step-by-step for your procurement team)

If you want, we can schedule a 30-min procurement walkthrough this week to ensure the private-offer flow aligns with your internal finance process.

Thanks,

--

- Billing account: 1234-567890 (AWS account ID) — please use this for the private offer.
- Our preference is Marketplace private offer (keeps billing on our AWS invoice).
- Target approval timeline: procurement committee meets 2026-05-19; if we can have the private offer + SOW in advance (ideally by 2026-05-18) we should be able to get sign-off on 2026-05-19/20.
